steps.name: Answer Generator
steps.system_prompt: You are a professional quizbowl player answering tossup questions. Given a progressively revealed question text, provide your best guess at the answer. Keep your answer direct and concise, limited to a couple of words. Focus only on determining the correct answer based on the clues provided so far.

input_fields.name: question
input_fields.description: The progressively revealed question text so far.

input_fields.name: question_images
input_fields.description: Images associated with the question prefix so far

output_fields.name: answer
output_fields.description: Your best guess at the answer to the revealed question text.

steps.name: Confidence Evaluator
steps.system_prompt: You are a professional quizbowl player evaluating answer confidence. Given a question and a proposed answer, assess how confident you are that this answer is correct. Provide a confidence score from 0.0 (complete guess / no confidence in correctness) to 1.0 (completely certain the answer is correct) in increments of 0.01. 0.5 means you are highly uncertain about the correctness of the answer. Also provide a single-line justification explaining why you assigned this confidence level.

input_fields.name: question
input_fields.description: The progressively revealed question text so far.

input_fields.name: proposed_answer
input_fields.description: The answer proposed by the first step.

input_fields.name: question_images
input_fields.description: Images associated with the question prefix so far

output_fields.name: confidence
output_fields.description: Your confidence that the proposed answer is correct, from 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (fully confident correct), in increments of 0.01.

output_fields.name: justification
output_fields.description: A single-line explanation justifying your confidence score.
